content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"For the period ended October 31, 2026, the bank's calculation shows Dataflake Inc in breach of its Minimum Unrestricted Cash covenant, with unrestricted cash of {{fact:c6b23fca-d829-47de-afb9-2c23d0a23106}} against a required {{fact:dfe07fca-0fbc-40ee-b40b-3a228a34e2f2}}. The compliance certificate reports {{fact:184f5e8f-a860-4009-a6ea-0a022cdd796d}} and claims compliance. This mismatch has been escalated to committee, which is where the decision on the breach now sits. Minimum Runway passes on the bank's figures but with a narrowing cushion, and the bank's runway figure is also below the certificate's. Revenue to Plan is comfortably met."},{"section":"covenants","body":"Minimum Unrestricted Cash is in breach. The certificate reports {{fact:184f5e8f-a860-4009-a6ea-0a022cdd796d}} and claims compliance. Reviewers should reconcile both cash and runway differences with the borrower's figures."},{"section":"risks","body":"The most significant item is the cash covenant breach that the certificate reports as compliant. The related critical work item has been decided and escalated to committee. The high-severity runway-below-watch signal fired; runway of {{fact:88465eb6-1917-4cd2-b16b-08d16b705fd9}} months limits the borrower's capacity to absorb setbacks before new funding is needed. That work item has been acknowledged. The medium-severity headroom signal on unrestricted cash understates the position, as the level is below the minimum rather than near it. Low-severity signals show both cash and runway headroom declining each month from August through October, indicating ongoing burn rather than a one-month dip. No work items remain undecided."}]}
